34' 3 - 0 Goal! Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Pascal Gross, then sends ball into the top left corner. 3:0.

33' 2 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Tariq Lamptey finds Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Dean Henderson had no chance of stopping that. 2:0.
32' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
